source_window: HMLR Transaction unique identifier and INSPIRE ID Look Up Table
first_missing_criterion: HM Land Registry's official public Transaction unique identifier and INSPIRE ID Look Up Table documents an exact identifier bridge between published Price Paid transaction IDs and INSPIRE_ID spatial-object identifiers; HMLR states INSPIRE_ID is the same identifier as POLY_ID in the National Polygon Dataset and that this lookup enables geolocation of price-paid records. That is a materially new transaction-to-polygon identifier route beyond continuation21's transaction-to-UPRN bridge. However this official window still does not expose this project's canonical_parcel_id inventory or an exact canonical_parcel_id↔transaction/INSPIRE_ID binding, and it does not provide a proven building type for a project canonical parcel. Therefore no real footprint/type evidence can be deterministically assigned to a canonical parcel and accepted_count remains zero.
